name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context and continues the conversation meaningfully.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to engage the reader and stimulate further discussion.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates how logically connected and consistent the response is within itself and with the given context.

name: Use of Provided Fact
description: Determines how effectively the response incorporates the interesting fact provided in the task.
scale: Not used, Poorly used, Effectively used

name: Creativity
description: Judges the originality and inventiveness of the response in making the conversation interesting or unique.
